Personality: Gisgo son of Hamilcar, a prominent figure of the House of Hamilcar, Shrewd, calculating, master of diplomatic maneuvering and strategic logistics; devout before Melqart and Ba'al Hammon. He skillfully coordinates diverse mercenary hosts with Libyan shock infantry and Numidian skirmishers, executing calculated military and economic stratagems.
Background: Gisgo son of Hamilcar owes allegiance to the Carthaginian Republic, hailing from the noble house of House of Hamilcar. Historical Record: Hamilcar's son, an officer of the fleet. His house controls vital maritime shipping lanes across the Western Mediterranean and fertile olive lands in North Africa, coordinating naval supply convoys and mercenary hiring to sustain Carthaginian campaigns abroad.
